title: SLAPBench: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Four-Finger SLAP Fingerprint Verification

bias_targets.methodology: Recomputing and comparing similarity-scoring performance metrics (AUC and EER) for fingerprint verification pairs strictly within male and female subgroups to measure performance disparity.
Recomputing and comparing similarity-scoring performance metrics (AUC and EER) for fingerprint verification pairs strictly within White and Black subgroups to identify demographic performance gaps.

Recomputing and comparing similarity-scoring performance metrics (AUC and EER) for fingerprint verification pairs across three distinct age bands (18-30, 31-45, and 46+) to evaluate age-related performance differences.

Evaluating 'positive-bias collapse' by measuring the False Accept Rate (FAR) under different prompting strategies to detect when models degenerate into predicting 'same person' for nearly all input pairs.
